name: Business & Entrepreneurship
tagline: Building and growing organisations from the ground up.
what: Strategy, operations, sales and entrepreneurship - spotting opportunities, building ventures and making organisations run better and grow faster.
salary: ₹3.5–7 LPA entry · ₹12–28 LPA mid · ₹40 LPA+ (leadership / founder equity)
future: Every industry needs people who can build, operate and grow organisations - one of the most transferable, founder-friendly domains.

name: Finance & Commerce
tagline: Making sense of money, risk and value.
what: Accounting, investing, banking and financial planning - the discipline of tracking, growing and protecting money for people and organisations.
salary: ₹3.5–8 LPA entry · ₹12–30 LPA mid · ₹45 LPA+ (CFO / fund management)
future: Every business needs finance - a durable, well-paid domain increasingly boosted by fintech and data analytics.

name: Engineering & Technology
tagline: Designing and building the physical world.
what: Turning ideas into real machines, structures, vehicles and energy systems - from engines and factories to bridges, aircraft and power grids.
salary: ₹3.5–7 LPA entry · ₹10–22 LPA mid · ₹30 LPA+ as lead / project manager
future: Infrastructure, EVs, clean energy and advanced manufacturing keep core engineering in steady, well-paid demand.

name: Computer Science & IT
what: Software, data, cloud, AI and cybersecurity - the systems that power modern life, and one of the fastest-growing, most remote-friendly fields.
salary: ₹4–10 LPA entry · ₹15–38 LPA mid · ₹55 LPA+ senior / lead
future: AI, cloud and data are reshaping every industry - the highest-paid, most globally portable of all the domains.

name: Medicine & Healthcare
tagline: Caring for human health and wellbeing.
what: Diagnosis, treatment, therapy, pharmacy and public health - deeply meaningful work with durable, worldwide demand.
salary: ₹3–6 LPA (allied / nursing) · ₹8–20 LPA (doctors post-PG) · ₹30 LPA+ specialists
future: Ageing populations, mental-health awareness and biotech guarantee stable, respected and rising demand.

name: Life Sciences & Agriculture
what: Agriculture, biology, biotechnology and food science - feeding the planet and unlocking the science of living things, from farms to labs.
salary: ₹3–6 LPA entry · ₹8–16 LPA mid · ₹22 LPA+ (agri-tech, biotech R&D)
future: Food security, biotech and precision agriculture are fast-growing, well-funded fields with rising industry investment.

name: Pure Sciences & Research
what: Physics, chemistry, maths and earth sciences - the fundamental research that eventually becomes every technology we use.
salary: ₹3–6 LPA entry (research) · ₹8–18 LPA mid · ₹25 LPA+ (senior scientist / professor)
future: Quantum computing, materials science and climate research are pulling fresh investment into fundamental science.

name: Architecture, Design & Creative Arts
tagline: Shaping how the world looks, feels and functions.
what: Architecture, product/graphic/fashion design and fine arts - turning ideas into spaces, objects and visuals people live with and love.
salary: ₹3–6 LPA entry · ₹8–18 LPA mid · ₹25 LPA+ senior (architecture / product design)
future: Sustainable architecture and digital product design keep creative, tech-aware talent in high demand.

name: Media & Communication
tagline: Telling stories that reach the world.
what: Journalism, content, film, advertising and PR - creating and distributing the stories, news and messages that shape public conversation.
salary: ₹2.5–5 LPA entry · ₹7–15 LPA mid · ₹22 LPA+ senior (editor / director / strategist)
future: Streaming, podcasts and creator platforms keep expanding paid opportunities well beyond traditional media.

name: Law, Government & Public Service
tagline: Upholding justice and serving the public.
what: Law, civil services, policy and public administration - interpreting rules, running government and protecting rights and society.
salary: ₹3–6 LPA entry · ₹8–18 LPA mid · higher in law practice & senior civil services
future: Legal-tech and policy careers are adding modern, well-paid branches to a traditionally stable domain.

name: Education & Psychology
tagline: Helping people learn, grow and understand themselves.
what: Teaching, counselling and psychology - shaping how people learn, think and cope, from classrooms to clinics.
salary: ₹2.5–5 LPA entry · ₹6–14 LPA mid · ₹20 LPA+ (senior academic / clinical roles)
future: Mental-health awareness and ed-tech are creating fast-growing, better-paid roles alongside traditional teaching.

name: Hospitality, Tourism & Events
what: Hotels, travel, tourism and event management - the booming experience economy built on service, planning and hospitality.
salary: ₹2.5–5 LPA entry · ₹6–14 LPA mid · ₹20 LPA+ (senior hotel / event management)
future: Travel, weddings and the experience economy keep growing worldwide, with strong scope for entrepreneurship.

name: Defence, Aviation & Transportation
tagline: Protecting the nation and keeping the world moving.
what: The armed forces, aviation and logistics - national security, flying aircraft, and moving people and goods around the world.
salary: ₹4–8 LPA entry · ₹10–25 LPA mid · ₹40 LPA+ (senior pilots / officers)
future: Air-travel growth and logistics automation keep steady demand for skilled aviation and transport professionals.

name: Environment & Sustainability
tagline: Protecting the planet for the future.
what: Environmental science, climate policy and sustainability consulting - measuring, protecting and fixing the natural systems we depend on.
salary: ₹3–6 LPA entry · ₹8–16 LPA mid · ₹22 LPA+ (ESG / sustainability leadership)
future: Climate regulation and ESG reporting requirements are creating fast-growing corporate and policy demand.

name: Sports & Fitness
tagline: Building performance, health and passion into a career.
what: Coaching, sports science, fitness training and sports media - turning athletic performance and wellbeing into a profession.
salary: ₹2.5–5 LPA entry · ₹6–14 LPA mid · ₹20 LPA+ (elite coaching / sports management)
future: Fitness culture, esports and sports-data analytics are opening new, well-paid career paths beyond playing professionally.
